# Codex Adversarial Review

Target: branch diff against e7ab1070af32c8c035b9ad1c0adc1f62967445f6
Verdict: needs-attention

No-ship: switching an existing Vertex connection back to the AI Studio card silently keeps using Vertex mode.

Findings:
- [high] Card changes retain the old Vertex transport flag (app/ai_connections.py:378-380)
  `_validate` starts with the newly selected card’s capabilities but then overlays all persisted capabilities from the old connection. A connection created from the Vertex card therefore retains `{"vertex": true}` when changed to the Gemini AI Studio card. `build_provider` selects the Vertex endpoint solely from that flag, so the supposedly AI Studio connection continues sending calls through Vertex (or fails with an AI Studio key), creating a billing and availability mismatch that is hard for the user to detect.
  Recommendation: Treat `vertex` as card-owned transport metadata: when `card` changes, discard/rebuild protocol capability flags from the destination card (or explicitly remove `vertex` unless the selected card defines it). Add a regression test that creates Vertex, updates it to `gemini`, and asserts `build_provider(...).vertexai is False`.

Next steps:
- Fix capability migration on card changes and add the regression test.
